title: Galaxies and filaments
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Matter tends to gather where filaments intersect. Those dense nodes can host galaxy groups and clusters, while less dense regions form voids.

misconception: A learner may choose: Only at the center of every void
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: In the cosmic web, where are massive galaxy clusters commonly found?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: In the cosmic web, where are massive galaxy clusters commonly found? At dense intersections of filaments. Matter tends to gather where filaments intersect. Those dense nodes can host galaxy groups and clusters, while less dense regions form voids.
Visual caption: Dense nodes host clusters. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
